items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He had pyorrhea and Louis Metcalf played the trumpet part. That was the first recording ever I made in my life.

ctx.x: 1928 right here in New York but he couldn't play. He had pyorrhea and Louis Metcalf played the trumpet part. That was the first recording ever I made in my life.
If Louis Metcalf played the trumpet, what did King Oliver do?
